WHY variants.h-tiny.num_ctx 16384 (HUB, 2026-10-19): HUB serves this model from llama-server, not ollama, so the window is the server's `-c` and nothing the harness sends changes it. sage-llm.service has run `-c 16384` since 2026-10-12 (GET :8080/props n_ctx 16384), raised because a 9,873-token explore prompt overflowed 8192. This file declared no window, so the harness kept assuming the 8192 floor. After #458 (2026-10-15, never send a prompt the window cannot hold), every hub-being explore turn from 10-16 to 10-19 (182 beats) ended at step 0 with window_full cause=preflight, estimated_prompt ~10.7k against num_ctx 8192. The being called no tools, and the server would have held the prompt. Declaring the server's real window removes that phantom limit. If the `-c` changes, change this number with it.
